{{ElectionsOH}}

The '''2026 Ohio gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of Ohio]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] entrepreneur [[Vivek Ramaswamy]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] former state health director [[Amy Acton]] are the nominees for their respective parties. Republican incumbent governor [[Mike DeWine]] is ineligible to seek a third consecutive term.

[[Primary elections]] were held on May 5, with Ramaswamy defeating minimal opposition for the Republican nomination and Acton running unopposed for the Democratic nomination. If elected, Ramaswamy would become Ohio's first [[Indian American]] and billionaire<ref>{{cite web |last1=Coolidge |first1=Alexander |title=Ramaswamy could be Ohio's first billionaire governor |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/politics/2026/07/21/vivek-ramaswamy-net-worth-how-he-made-his-billions/90593373007/ |website=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |date=July 21, 2026 |access-date=July 21, 2026}}</ref> governor and the first [[Hindus|Hindu]] governor in the United States.{{Efn|[[Bobby Jindal]] was raised Hindu but converted to Christianity as a teenager.}} Acton would be the first woman elected to the office{{Efn|Acton would be the first woman elected governor, but would be the second to serve in the position. [[Nancy Hollister]] served as governor, albeit for only 11 days, following [[George Voinovich]]'s resignation to join the [[U.S. Senate]]. To date, Hollister is the only woman to have served as governor of Ohio.}} and the state's first Jewish governor.

Democrats have not won a gubernatorial election in Ohio since [[2006 Ohio gubernatorial election|2006]]. The winner of the election will be inaugurated on January 11, 2027.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Muhammad |first1=Mariyam |title=Can Mike DeWine run for Ohio governor in 2026? What to know about term limits |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/2024/11/08/mike-dewine-run-ohio-governor-2026-state-law-says/76111304007/ |website=[[The Columbus Dispatch]] |access-date=February 5, 2025}}</ref>

== General election ==
On September 2, Ramaswamy accepted invitations to participate in gubernatorial debates hosted by [[CNN]] and [[WLWT]] and called on Acton to join him. Acton's campaign subsequently declined, citing what it characterized as inaccurate and personal attacks in Ramaswamy's campaign advertising. As a result, no debates between the two major-party nominees have been scheduled.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Bischoff |first1=Laura A. |title=Amy Acton refuses to debate Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio governor's race |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/state/2026/09/02/ohio-governor-candidates-may-not-debate-find-out-why/91585349007/ |website=[[The Columbus Dispatch]] |date=September 2, 2026 |access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref>

On September 6, Acton was attacked at a campaign event at the [[Canfield, Ohio|Canfield]] Fair. An armed individual lunged at her and was apprehended by local authorities. Several campaign volunteers suffered minor injuries.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Knue |first=Kurt |date=September 6, 2026 |title=Amy Acton attacked at campaign event near Youngstown; multiple people reportedly injured |url=https://www.wlwt.com/article/amy-acton-attacked-at-campaign-event-near-youngstown/73625988 |access-date=September 6, 2026 |website=WLWT |language=en}}</ref> The suspect, Patrick Havas, was charged with "two counts of assault and one count of disorderly conduct."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Ziegler |first1=Jen |title=Armed man arrested after pushing toward Amy Acton is brother of Ramaswamy donor who quit Husted campaign |url=https://tiffinohio.net/posts/patrick-havas-arrested-acton-attack-brother-ramaswamy-donor/ |website=TiffinOhio.net |date=September 6, 2026 |access-date=September 25, 2026}}</ref>
